## Checklist

- [ ] It targets `dev` for a new feature, or `main` for a fix to the stable release
- [ ] It does one thing (unrelated changes go in their own pull request)
- [ ] `scripts/ci-preflight.sh` passes
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` are updated if what people see or do changed
- [ ] No passwords, keys or real addresses in the code, tests or screenshots
